```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false


### Read in data here
actions_data <- read.csv("../data/green-actions-workflows.csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: calculate statistics
#| message: false

mean_duration <- mean(actions_data$duration)
duration_quant <- quantile(actions_data$duration)
branches <- unique(actions_data$branch)

# Calculate the quartiles and colors for each branch
get_branch_stats <- function(branch_name){

}

branch_first <- actions_data |>
    filter(branch==branches[1])
branch_second <- actions_data |>
    filter(branch==branches[2])
branch_third <- actions_data |>
    filter(branch==branches[3])
p_firstblock <- "warning"
p_secondblock <- "danger"
p_thirdblock <- "primary"

```

## Row {height="20%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total time"
list(
  icon = "clock",
  color = p_firstblock,
  value = mean_duration
)

```


```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Time for branch X"
list(
  icon = "clock",
  color = p_secondblock,
  value = mean_duration
)

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Time for branch Y"
list(
  icon = "clock",
  color = p_thirdblock,
  value = mean_duration
)
```

